title: Day One Biopharmaceuticals, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-23
summary: Servier Pharmaceuticals LLC completed its acquisition of Day One Biopharmaceuticals, Inc. through a cash tender offer that expired at 11:59 p.m. ET on April 22, 2026. Approximately 85.34% of shares were tendered, satisfying the Minimum Tender Condition, and the deal closed on April 23, 2026. Shareholders received $21.50 per share in cash.
key_points: Servier acquired Day One Biopharmaceuticals (NASDAQ: DAWN) for $21.50 per share in cash
Tender offer expired at 11:59 p.m. ET on April 22, 2026; 88,180,910 shares tendered (85.34% of outstanding)
Acquisition completed on April 23, 2026 via merger under Delaware Section 251(h), with Day One becoming a wholly owned subsidiary of Servier
Unvested stock options accelerated and were cashed out at the difference between $21.50 and exercise price
Deal was originally announced on March 6, 2026
